product_one_liner.value: Leena AI provides enterprise AI colleagues that answer employee requests and automate HR, IT, finance and procurement workflows across existing business systems.

pricing_page.notes: Lists Universal Assistant and AI Colleagues Platform pricing structures; numeric prices require a custom quote.

hq_location.notes: The company profile explicitly identifies San Francisco as headquarters; PitchBook instead lists New York, where the official site also lists an office.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering-authored posts cover voice-release reliability testing and the architecture of an open-source agentic-system benchmark.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page and job board exist, but the complete current role list could not be read. A Machine Learning Engineer advertisement is visible on an aggregator, but its continued availability could not be established; neither a current opening nor a reliable negative could be verified.

model_provider.value: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, and Amazon Bedrock (Anthropic).
model_provider.notes: Public documentation describes a multi-provider model picker configurable at orchestrator and individual workflow levels.

compliance_certs.notes: These are public compliance claims; GDPR and HIPAA are included as requested, without implying that each is a formal third-party certification.

last_funding.notes: IBM Ventures investment announced October 20, 2026; the amount was not disclosed, so amount_usd is omitted.

raised_18mo.notes: IBM Ventures investment announced October 20, 2026, inside the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Enterprise Sales Development Representative – US posting, based in Bengaluru, dated September 11, 2026.
